title: Ordered spectral-coefficient lattice inclusions
statement: Let ell and p be distinct primes, k a field of characteristic p, E any finite dimensional extension of Q_ell equipped with its canonical spectral norm, and S a separated finite-type k-scheme. For the actual condensed continuous-function rings O_E and E [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], their inclusion [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map], and any lisse E_S-module [sk-lem-coefficient-heart], there is a finite locally closed scheme stratification of S [def-constructible-stratification] with open prefixes. On every stratum there is a lisse O_E-module and a monomorphism into the scalar restriction of the corresponding restriction of L. The scalar-extension adjoint of this very monomorphism is invertible [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. The coefficient field may live in the same arbitrary universe as S; finite ranks may vary and may be zero. Empty schemes and empty strata are permitted.

proof.text: Finite dimensionality gives a small Q_ell-algebra model of E, by choosing a finite basis. Transport its spectral norm and valuation ring along this algebra equivalence. Postcomposition and its inverse give continuous-function ring isomorphisms, natural in profinite test objects and compatible with inclusion. The induced module equivalences transport finite free charts, monicity, and the adjunction unit. Apply [sk-lem-stratified-lattice] on S to this small model and transport its stratified lattice inclusions and their scalar-extension adjoints back to E. Reuse the already proved finite-free transport helpers of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-lfp-local-triviality] to identify normalized lisse charts with the raw locally-free predicate.

Finite type over k makes S Noetherian. Apply the ordered common-refinement theorem [new-det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification-refinement] to the obtained partition. For each refined piece take its fibre product over S with the original scheme stratum that contains its image. The projection is an immersion onto exactly the refined subset, and its other projection gives an actual morphism into the original stratum; this avoids inferring a scheme factorization merely from containment of images. Its image partition retains the disjointness, covering, and open-prefix conditions.

Pull the lattice back along that actual refinement morphism. The canonical coefficient inverse image, whose finite-limit preservation is already part of the module pullback API, preserves the monomorphism and local finite free charts. The scalar/pullback comparison carries the scalar-extension adjoint to the pullback of the original adjoint, hence it is invertible. Pullback composition identifies its rational target with the restriction of L to the refined piece. Empty S gives an empty partition; rank zero and empty strata produce zero modules and do not require strict inclusions. The ordinaryScalarUnit helper of [new-integral-residue-pull-ordinary-unit], reused through a proof-only import all, identifies the adjoint of the pulled inclusion with the actual pullIso component followed by pullback of its old adjoint. The raw locally-free cover predicate and normalized lisse predicate are related by extension along the invertible condensedPullbackHom.

theorem exists_orderedSpectralLattices (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p] (_hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [S.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] :
  letI := spectralNorm.nontriviallyNormedField ℚ_[ℓ] E
  let A := coefficientHeartRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafOfUniverse.{u, u}
    (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers ℓ E))
  letI : IsCommMonObj A := Sheaf.isCommMonObj_sheafCompose_obj _
    (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafOfUniverse.{u, u}
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers ℓ E))
      (fun U (a b : ULift.{u + 1} C(U.unop, Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers ℓ E)) ↦
        mul_comm a b)
  let B := coefficientHeartRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafOfUniverse.{u, u} E)
  letI : IsCommMonObj B := Sheaf.isCommMonObj_sheafCompose_obj _
    (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafOfUniverse.{u, u} E)
      (fun U (a b : ULift.{u + 1} C(U.unop, E)) ↦ mul_comm a b)
  let c := (sheafCompose (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
    (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMapOfUniverse.{u, u}
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers ℓ E).subtype continuous_subtype_val)
  ∀ L : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj B S),
    IsLisseCoefficientModule B L →
    ∃ R : S.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification,
      (∀ b : Fin (R.n + 1),
        IsOpen (⋃ i : Fin R.n, ⋃ (_ : i.val < b.val), R.stratum i)) ∧
      ∃ M : ∀ b : Fin R.n,
        Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (R.domain b)) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj A (R.domain b)),
        ∀ b : Fin R.n, IsLisseCoefficientModule A (M b) ∧
          ∃ ι : M b ⟶ (Mod.comap ((upperStarFromPoint (R.domain b)).map c)).obj
              ((CondensedRing.upperStar B (R.immersion b)).obj L),
            Mono ι ∧ IsIso
              (((Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction ((upperStarFromPoint (R.domain b)).map c)).homEquiv
                (M b) ((CondensedRing.upperStar B (R.immersion b)).obj L)).symm ι)
